overview.title: A clear view of what a learner knows
overview.intro: Tutors build versioned assessments from question pools. Students receive a timed, focused workspace. Families receive a tutor’s considered report after a conversation.

contract.title: Activity signals provide context, not proof
contract.body: The assessment can record timing, focus, fullscreen, connection, copy/paste, and answer-change events. A tutor reviews them alongside the work; the system does not make an accusation.

prepare.label: Tutor
prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.body: Author versioned questions, choose pool sizes, and set time or fullscreen requirements.

take.label: Student
take.title: Take
take.body: See the collection notice, work through a randomized paper, and confirm the honor statement.

review.label: Tutor + family
review.title: Understand
review.body: Review answers and activity context, consult together, then release a tutor-written diagnostic.

library.title: Available assessments
library.empty: No assessments are available yet. Tutors can create one through the assessment API.
library.noDescription: Open the assessment brief and collection notice.

entry.noDescription: Review the details and activity notice before you begin.

notice.label: Before you begin
notice.title: This assessment records activity signals
notice.body: You will see the same kinds of activity a tutor may review after the assessment:
notice.focus: tab or focus changes and fullscreen exits
notice.connection: connection interruptions and detectable copy/paste attempts
notice.notProof: These signals provide context only. They are not proof of misconduct and never produce an automatic accusation.

ready.title: Ready to begin?
ready.fullscreen: Starting opens the focused fullscreen workspace. Leaving fullscreen is recorded as an activity signal.
ready.standard: The question order and values are fixed for this attempt once you start.

entry.cameraConsent: I explicitly consent to the camera requirement described in policy {policy}. I understand this slice does not record video or analyze my face or emotions.

runner.elapsedNotice: Time has elapsed. Your saved answers remain available; accept the honor statement to submit them.
runner.question: Question {current} of {total}

submit.title: Submit your saved answers
submit.body: You can review your answers above. The honor statement is required before submission.
submit.honor: I confirm that this submission reflects my own work and that I followed the assessment instructions.

complete.title: Your assessment is complete
complete.body: Your tutor can now review the answers and activity context. Any diagnostic report is written by the tutor and shared with your family after consultation.

signals.title: Recorded signals
signals.contract: Counts describe browser activity only. They do not establish intent or prove misconduct. Review them with the answers and speak with the learner when context is needed.

answers.title: Student answers
answers.changes: {count, plural, one {# saved change} other {# saved changes}}

report.title: Diagnostic report
report.body: Write the interpretation in your own words. Browser events are context, not a generated conclusion.

release.title: Consult before sharing
release.waiting: The report remains private to teaching staff until the parent consultation is recorded.
release.consulted: Consultation recorded. Review the report once more before releasing it to the linked parent.
release.released: The report has been released to the linked parent.

errors.load: The assessment could not be loaded.
errors.start: The assessment could not be started.
errors.save: This answer could not be saved.
errors.submit: The assessment could not be submitted.
errors.review: The attempt review could not be loaded.
errors.report: The diagnostic report could not be updated.
